name: Redcliff Cut
description: A road cutting through a red sandstone ridge, its walls streaked green where the copper shows through.

discovery.message: Green streaks run through the red rock of a cutting: copper, and plenty of it.

face.text: The cutting's walls are banded red and green. Copper close to the surface, and rust-brown iron below it. Easy work for a pick.

leave.text: You shoulder your pack and leave the seam behind.
